capabilities.statement: the vault walk lists only Markdown files, skipping hidden entries at every level
capabilities.mechanism: `scan_vault` recurses with `MAX_NOTES` 2000 and `MAX_DEPTH` 16, skips any name starting with `.`, takes only `.md` case-insensitively, and sorts by vault-relative path so the list, the index and the graph agree
capabilities.row: Vault model

capabilities.statement: a note or directory that resolves outside the vault is skipped and counted, never listed
capabilities.mechanism: the walk canonicalizes every link and directory against the canonical root and keeps only what stays inside; the count travels as `ScanResult.outside` to the pane footer
capabilities.row: The vault walk follows symlinks the note reader refuses

capabilities.statement: a re-index reads only the notes whose modification time or size changed
capabilities.mechanism: `index_vault` compares each walked note's (mtime, size) with the indexed row, re-reads only a mismatch, drops vanished rows only from a complete walk, and rewrites rows and their links in one transaction
capabilities.row: Vault model

capabilities.statement: note titles and bodies are searchable as prose, ranked by relevance
capabilities.mechanism: an external-content FTS5 table behind `notes` with three sync triggers, `bm25()` ordering and a 24-token `snippet()`; the store lives in the app's state directory, never inside the vault

capabilities.statement: a caller searches a vault by free text and gets a path, a title and context for each hit
capabilities.mechanism: the query is reduced to quoted word terms (32 at most, ANDed) before `MATCH`, the limit is clamped to 1..500, and the control-socket verb re-indexes first so an outside edit is searchable

capabilities.statement: opening a note returns at most 1 MiB of text and refuses anything that is not a regular file
capabilities.mechanism: `read_vault_note` resolves the path inside the vault, requires a regular file so a planted FIFO cannot block the caller, cuts at `MAX_NOTE_BYTES` with the torn UTF-8 tail dropped, and reports the CRLF flag and the stamp

capabilities.statement: saving a note replaces the file atomically, and only if the loaded revision is unchanged
capabilities.mechanism: a hidden temp sibling with a random name is written, given the note's own mode, then renamed over it; an (mtime, size) mismatch answers `changed_on_disk` unless the caller forces the save

capabilities.statement: a note can be created without overwriting, and deleted without following a link out of the vault
capabilities.mechanism: create claims the path with `create_new` after its directory resolves inside the root; delete unlinks the entry itself, so a symlinked note's target stays where it is

capabilities.statement: a note can be renamed inside the vault without replacing an existing file
capabilities.mechanism: the destination is claimed with `create_new` before the rename, its directory must resolve inside the vault, and a failed move removes the claim it left behind

capabilities.statement: a note's `[[mentions]]` are parsed with their line, alias and heading fragment
capabilities.mechanism: `parse_links` scans line by line and skips fenced blocks, inline code spans and escaped openers, keeping at most 512 occurrences per note and targets up to 1024 bytes

capabilities.statement: a mention resolves to a note by path or by unique stem, and an ambiguity stays unresolved
capabilities.mechanism: a target containing `/` matches a path and a bare target a file stem; exact case wins, then a unique case-insensitive match, and more than one match answers the sorted candidates

capabilities.statement: the open note lists what it mentions, what mentions it, and what does not resolve
capabilities.mechanism: `links_for` reads the stored rows in both directions, re-parses the body to attach the fragment the table does not keep, and derives ambiguity candidates by re-running the same resolver
capabilities.row: Wikilinks & backlinks - the pane half

capabilities.statement: renaming a note offers to respell the mentions that used its old name before writing any
capabilities.mechanism: a preview returns files, mentions, skipped and truncated counts; the apply rewrites only occurrences that resolved to the moved note, keeps alias, fragment and line endings, and writes each through `write_vault_note`
capabilities.row: Create, rename, and delete notes

capabilities.statement: the link graph is one edge per note pair plus one ghost node per unresolved target
capabilities.mechanism: `graph_limited` aggregates mentions per ordered pair, orders by count then name, caps edges at 10000 and ghosts at 2000, and reports `truncated` instead of presenting a cut graph as whole

capabilities.statement: the graph's layout is deterministic and a click selects the nearest node or edge
capabilities.mechanism: a hash-seeded relaxation with 24..240 sweeps keeps positions the view already holds; hit tests take the nearest node within 11 screen pixels or the nearest edge segment within 6, each converted to world units by the zoom

capabilities.statement: the link graph can be shown as a physical 3D map whose nodes push their neighbours and whose arrangement survives a restart
capabilities.mechanism: `VaultGraph3D` runs one `RigidBody3D` per node and one spring per drawn edge in an own-world `SubViewport`; depth is a deterministic per-id layer; a drag holds one body and rewrites its incident rest lengths on release; the simulation freezes when settled or hidden; the canonical `{id: [x, y]}` block rides the pane's layout state capped at 4000 entries, and a deleted note is ignored
capabilities.row: The vault graph is a physical 3D map you can push around

capabilities.statement: opening the link graph does not stall the frame, whatever the vault's size
capabilities.mechanism: the index query, the model parse and the layout run as one `WorkerThreadPool` task; the pane polls it, and a result for a vault the pane has left is dropped rather than drawn
capabilities.row: Opening the link graph blocks the frame, and `pane-view --graph` inherits it

capabilities.statement: an authored weight from 1 to 100 can override an edge's measured thickness and panel order
capabilities.mechanism: `user://link_weights.json` keyed (vault, source, target) with path-shape and range checks; a bad entry costs itself, and no decision other than display reads a declaration
capabilities.row: Declared edge weights - the authored layer

capabilities.statement: a declared weight follows a note renamed inside the pane
capabilities.mechanism: the rename path calls `rekey_note`, rebuilding both endpoint keys to the new path; an outside move looks like a delete here and its declarations are pruned instead
capabilities.row: A note rename does not re-key its declared link weights

capabilities.statement: a declared weight survives a note moved by a program other than this one
capabilities.mechanism: it does not: a complete graph prunes declarations whose endpoints vanished, and an outside move cannot be told from a deletion, so following one needs an explicit graph-side action
capabilities.row: Declared link weights cannot follow a note moved outside gPTY

capabilities.statement: note text is rendered as Markdown through a sanitized path, never as raw markup
capabilities.mechanism: `GptyMarkdown.render` escapes raw HTML and BBCode, reduces images to alt text, admits only http, https and mailto link targets, and emits indented list lines instead of list tags
capabilities.row: Safe Markdown rendering

capabilities.statement: a note at the read cap renders whole, and a larger source says what it did not show
capabilities.mechanism: `MAX_MARKDOWN_BYTES` is the same 1 MiB the note reader cuts at, and the answer carries `truncated`, `shown` and `size` for the view's notice
capabilities.row: The Markdown preview no longer stops at a cap of its own

capabilities.statement: a link naming a note's heading lands on that heading in the preview
capabilities.mechanism: `MarkdownAnchors` scans ATX headings past frontmatter and fenced blocks, exact text first then case-insensitive, and `MarkdownView` scrolls to the matching rendered line
capabilities.row: Wikilink navigation polish - heading fragments, line jumps, and nested labels

capabilities.statement: a link naming a setext heading lands on that heading
capabilities.mechanism: the scanner recognizes ATX headings only, so a title over `===` renders but derives no anchor and the jump falls to the ATX heading above it
capabilities.row: Setext headings have no anchor

capabilities.statement: a note is edited in place with an optional live preview of the unsaved buffer
capabilities.mechanism: edit, split and preview modes persist as the tile's `view_mode`; the preview renders the buffer after a 0.4 s quiet window, and edit mode renders nothing
capabilities.row: Markdown editor & preview

capabilities.statement: a note with unsaved text asks before the pane, or the app, takes the buffer away
capabilities.mechanism: `request_close` runs the same save-or-discard question as leaving the note, and `has_unsaved_state` lets a caller that cannot answer a dialog refuse instead
capabilities.row: Closing a pane or quitting the app loses unsaved wiki edits

capabilities.statement: a dirty buffer is snapshotted outside the vault and offered back after a crash
capabilities.mechanism: a throttled 1.5 s copy under the state directory is keyed by a stated FNV-1a hash of the canonical root and path, written atomically and owner-only, then offered as Restore, Discard or later on reopen
capabilities.row: A crash no longer takes the wiki buffer

capabilities.statement: a note whose file opens with a properties block is titled by its first heading
capabilities.mechanism: `note_title` skips a closed `---` block before scanning for a heading and falls back to the file stem; the block itself is indexed and renders as ordinary text
capabilities.row: A note with frontmatter loses its title in search results

capabilities.statement: the wiki pane lists a vault, searches it as the user types, and reopens the note it showed
capabilities.mechanism: the list is one `vault_index` call with a footer for a capped listing and skipped links; search debounces 0.15 s for 200 hits; `open_note` and `graph` replay once from the saved tile state
capabilities.row: Wiki pane type

capabilities.statement: the control-socket vault verbs answer only inside a root the user registered
capabilities.mechanism: `user://vaults.json` is written by the pane settings UI alone and mirrored into the extension's process; a caller naming an unregistered root is refused with `not_registered`

capabilities.statement: a template's tokens are expanded into the open note as an edit
capabilities.mechanism: no expander exists; the planned token table is closed (date, time, title, vault), expanded in Rust and inserted as an edit so no second write path into the vault opens
capabilities.row: Templates
